settings.label: Preset
settings.description: Vanilla: the game's loot. Balanced: the game's chances, plus a second roll for empty containers and a 30% chance of 1-5 extra items. Loot Overhaul: 70% of containers hold something, more rare and medical items. Mega Loot: far more of everything, every stash on the map. Custom: the numbers below.

settings.label: Custom: common loot chance
settings.description: Chance a container rolls common items (the game: 0.20).

settings.label: Custom: jackpot chance
settings.description: A full container: rare and common items, sometimes a legendary (the game: 0.01).

settings.label: Custom: re-roll empty containers
settings.description: Chance an empty container rolls a second time.

settings.label: Custom: bonus items chance
settings.description: Chance of a few extra common items on top.

settings.label: Custom: worst weapon condition
settings.description: Weapons, lights and night vision found in containers (the game: 25-100%).

settings.label: Custom: every stash on the map
settings.description: Stashes normally appear only 10% of the time.

settings.label: Custom: keys more common
settings.description: 1 = the game. 4 = keys four times as likely.
